reason: The hypothesis combines the known problem of Cr-Zr interdiffusion in Cr-coated Zr cladding (P1, P2) with the concept of using Al to form a stable alumina diffusion barrier (P36, P39, P42) in a new material system (Cr coating on Zr alloy). No passage proposes Al doping of Cr coatings for Zr cladding, nor does any passage link Al2O3 formation to suppressing Cr-Zr interdiffusion in this context. The idea synthesizes two separate bodies of literature into a single, non-obvious proposal.
